prospective_note: every pull request in this population was merged before the protocol was frozen. This is a shadow over the recent merged traffic of public repositories the product has never reviewed, not a prospective run, and no claim from it may say otherwise.
population_rule: the first six candidates, in the recorded order, whose free evaluability probe passes (probe.json); fewer pass, and the population is what passes
unit: one merged pull request; head = its merge commit (what the target branch became when it landed, a squash and a merge commit alike) and base = that commit's first parent, which is the target branch as it stood the moment before and therefore merge-base(head, target branch at merge time). The diff base..head is exactly what the pull request contributed.
selection: per repository, the four most recently merged pull requests by merged_at descending that changed at least one Python file of the package itself -- a .py file outside tests/, docs/, examples/ and packaging scaffolding -- and whose diff does not exceed 2000 changed lines (additions plus deletions, from the GitHub API's file list). A pull request that fails either rule is recorded in selection.json with its reason and the walk continues. The merge commit must resolve in the read-only clone; one that does not is recorded and skipped.
order: round-robin across repositories in name order, four per repository, newest merged first within a repository, so a cost cap removes units evenly rather than whole repositories
exclusion_declared_before_any_run: none beyond the selection rule. No unit is excluded after its outcome is known, nothing is re-sampled and nothing is retried.
switches: value_notes_visible and gate_notes_visible on for every unit, so every author-visible line is recorded to the lines file; contained_attempt_voids at the product default (D-226); intent_replies off (no GitHub client exists on this path)
smoke: before the units are bought, exactly one unit is run under --limit 1 into a separate trials file (trials-smoke.jsonl) with the per-unit budget lowered to $0.30 by --unit-budget. It is a pipeline check that the artifact carries a ledger and a lines file (AGENTS.md section 9), never a measurement: the same unit is bought again at $1.00 in the main run and only that trial counts.
reservation: a unit is admitted under the run's cap at the 95th percentile of the most recent forty cases' spend across this study's trials files, the ceiling standing below ten cases of history (D-244); the unit's own budget is $1.00
truth: the owner adjudicates every author-visible line by hand into three columns (useful / true but not actionable / wrong) in the dated report; no line is adjudicated by this study's code. The owner writes the adjudication before reading the agent's opinion of any line (owner instruction 2 of 2026-09-14).
retries: none; a unit that cannot run is recorded with its DEFER or refusal reason
silence_reporting: every silent unit records units_read and units_total; a silence over a partly-read pull request covers only what was read
code: main after D-240 (attest.intent.v5.1), D-241, D-242, D-243 and D-244, at the SHA the run records
freeze_at_note: provisional at creation; rewritten by the freeze step (the host clock, UTC) immediately before selection
